verdict.rationale: Zep's docs describe a Context Block that `scope="auto"` dynamically composes from edges, nodes, episodes, observations and thread summaries into a single ready-to-use block. It can be fetched with `thread.get_user_context()` or returned directly from `thread.add_messages(return_context=True)`, and sub-200ms retrieval is claimed. That covers the one-call, prompt-ready core of the story. Missing for 10: any evidence of token budgeting or size limits on the context block, and independent or hands-on corroboration of block assembly.
